resume.name: Daniel Ng
resume.summary: Technology associate with transferable experience in SIEM, incident triage and log analysis. Demonstrated capability to monitor security alerts using SIEM and improve team turnaround by 41%. Applied log analysis to triage suspicious activity and documented decisions for technical and business reviewers. Collaborated with four colleagues to analyse endpoint and network logs and presented progress during reviews. Supported operational work using network security and documented step-by-step procedures. Investigated service requests, recorded findings and escalated issues with clear supporting evidence. Built a fictional demonstration project using SIEM, incident triage and log analysis. Tested the project with representative scenarios and recorded limitations and next steps. Presented the design and outcomes to a five-person peer review group. Seeking to deepen capability as a SOC Analyst.
